projectMeta.rythm: Rythm brings music discovery and shared listening into one connected experience. Explore a personalized feed, manage playlists, and listen with friends in real time across supported platforms.
projectMeta.unimatic: Unimatic blends minimalist Italian design with rigorous functional engineering to create high-performance dive and toolwatches. Built for durability with 300m water resistance, these timepieces transcend simple utility through iconic, meticulously crafted aesthetics.
projectMeta.penti: Penti is an agentic AI cybersecurity platform that provides continuous security validation. It simulates real-world attacks across your applications, APIs, and infrastructure to expose vulnerabilities and prove exactly what an attacker can reach.
projectMeta.miraLife: Mira Life measures your personal capacity across six key dimensions to help you understand your true potential. By analyzing your daily habits, mood, and health metrics, it provides scientific, actionable insights to manage your energy without overwhelming you.
projectMeta.subscrr: Subscrr keeps all your subscriptions in one secure place with reminders, insights, and honest totals. It helps you track your expenses, discover where your money goes, and avoid surprise charges across your Apple devices.

privacyPolicy.name: Privacy
privacyPolicy.title: Privacy policy & cookies
privacyPolicy.p1: Your privacy matters to us. This site uses a small preference cookie to remember your language choice. We don't use advertising or analytics cookies to track your browsing activity.
privacyPolicy.p2: Our only goal is to share our work with you. Nothing more, nothing less.
privacyPolicy.p3: That said, our website is hosted by a third-party provider, and they might use their own cookies for things like security or basic site performance. That part is outside of our control, but from our side, we keep things as cookie-free as possible.
privacyPolicy.p4: We believe thoughtful work needs curiosity, collaboration, and time away from the screen. Support local makers, stay curious, and leave room for good ideas to grow.
privacyPolicy.p5: Today, imagine it. Tomorrow, ship it.

faq.title: A few things to know before we work together.

questions.question: What kind of projects do you take on?
questions.answer: We work on distinctive websites, digital products, mobile and SaaS applications, and motion-led experiences. The best fit is a project where thoughtful design and solid engineering matter equally.

questions.question: Who will actually work on my project?
questions.answer: You work directly with the people shaping and building your project. We keep communication close and bring in specialist support only when the project calls for it.

questions.question: How long does a project usually take?
questions.answer: It depends on scope and complexity. A focused website can take several weeks, while a larger digital product may need a few months. We agree on milestones and priorities before work begins.

questions.question: How do you manage communication and feedback?
questions.answer: We agree on a clear point of contact, regular check-ins and shared milestones. Feedback is gathered at defined moments so decisions stay clear and progress keeps moving.

questions.question: What do you need to get started?
questions.answer: A conversation about your goals, audience, constraints and what success looks like is enough to begin. Existing brand assets, references or technical requirements are helpful, but they don't need to be perfectly prepared.

questions.question: Can you work with an existing brand or product?
questions.answer: Absolutely. We can build on what already works, refine the visual direction, redesign an existing website or improve a product without forcing a complete rebrand.

questions.question: What happens after launch?
questions.answer: We can help with handover, fixes and agreed follow-up improvements. The exact level of ongoing support is defined around your needs and the way your product will evolve.

questions.question: How is the project investment determined?
questions.answer: The investment depends on the scope, complexity, timeline and level of collaboration involved. After an initial conversation, we can define a realistic scope and provide a tailored estimate.
